title: Easy Appletini Cocktail Recipe by Better Sweet Drinks
description: The “appletini” is a delectable vodka-based cocktail that tantalizes your taste buds, leaving you wanting more! With myriad variations, the stunning electric green beverage with a delicious sweet and sour tang is perfect for those with a very sweet tooth as well as those who want a little twist on their tongue!
author: Better Sweet Drinks
instructions:
Make the Apple Juice

  1. Take 5 cups of water, a quarter cup of white sugar, and 3 peels and cores from red apples (remove seeds).
  2. Add water with apple peels and cores in a saucepan.
  3. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, and let it simmer. Keep stirring for 30 minutes.
  4. Strain the juice into a mixing bowl, add sugar, mix well and let it cool.

Mix the Ingredients

  1. Mix the apple juice and lemon juice in the shaker. Give it a firm shake.
  2. Add the green apple schnapps (please stick to the above mentioned measurement to achieve the desired taste), and shake again!
  3. Pour the vodka (I use Absolut Vodka for my cocktails), fill the shaker halfway up with ice, cap it, and give a brisk shake.
  4. Slowly pour the cocktail using a mesh strainer, into a martini glass.

Garnish

  1. Garnish with fresh apple slices and serve.
  2. A single cherry can be added to the drink.
  3. A slight twist can be added with a cinnamon stick, as the strong, warm notes of the cinnamon harmonize lusciously with the fruity apple flavors.
notes: If you don’t want to deal with the hassle of preparing this easy appletini recipe before a party, just pre-batch it. Pour the ingredients into a bottle and refrigerate. Simply mix them in a cocktail shaker and serve.
